verdicts.reason: On Node 24.19.0 the reviewed new preflight resolved with eight entries while its signal was already aborted when abortion occurred in the eighth timer callback; lines 332–334 return after that yield without another cancelled() check.

The reviewed preflight accepted an independently generated workbook whose double-quoted formatCode contained an apostrophe followed by 300 zeros, because line 47 stops at the opposite quote and bypasses the documented 256-character pre-parser cap.

The reviewed preflight rejected a valid A1:A2 worksheet containing inline string ref="ORDER-123" with Invalid worksheet address, reproducing how lines 82–84 treat source text as structural attributes.

On Node 24.19.0 independently generated malformed worksheets with 10000, 20000 and 40000 unterminated cell prefixes took 261, 976 and 3782 ms respectively, confirming quadratic synchronous scanning at line 87 for a reachable 2410-byte hostile ZIP.

Inspection shows the test asserts only eventual cancellation and never stream cancellation or listener cleanup; an in-memory copy of the reviewed preflight with abort-listener registration removed still passed its exact representative-workbook cancellation assertion on Node 24.19.0, proving that regression escapes the test.
